headline: Trump Pauses Threat to Strike Iranian Energy Infrastructure Amid High-Stakes Talks, Deploying UK Submarine
summary: Ongoing US-Iran tensions, marked by explicit US threats to strike Iranian power plants and a temporary pause for negotiations, signal extreme geopolitical volatility in West Asia. This situation directly jeopardizes global energy supply chains and regional stability, with a UK nuclear submarine deployment further highlighting heightened military readiness and potential for swift escalation affecting international trade and logistics.
